Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Joyce Hunter, Darrell Yates Rist, and Evan Wolfson 2. AIDS and the right to privacy, with special reference to public figures COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 3. The media's ignoring gay-related news stories in their year-in-review issues, gay visibility 4. Gay survivors of AIDS deaths, legal victories, and marriage rights COMMERCIAL: GCN's "Year in Review" 5. Andy Humm on Reagan's lack of AIDS funding in 1987 budget 6. New law forbids the Military from using HIV testing program for "adverse actions" against gay service members 7. Denver, St John Episcopal Cathedral opens a housing complex exclusively for people with AIDS 8. Tennessee, Tri-Cities AIDS project conduct awareness education 9. San Francisco man successfully challenges his insurance company to gain health benefits 10. Minnesota, governor issues executive order banning discrimination based on sexual orientation for state employees 11. Lutheran Church of America encourages the welcoming of homosexuals as full members of their community 12. Minneapolis, procurator for a male prostitution service charged with one year in a workhouse for exposing prostitutes to AIDS 13. Sports Report, interview with bowler "Gutter George" 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, clips from a show about witch doctors in South Africa dealing with AIDS 3. Announcement of book, "Conversations with my Elders" by Boze Hadleigh 4. Interview with Nicholas Deutsch, director of the off-Broadway play "Jerker" COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 5. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of the off-Broadway play "Groucho: A Life in Review" COMMERCIAL: The Monster 6. Razor Sharp gives etiquette pointers for telephone sex COMMERCIAL: TeleContractor phone sex hotline
